✓
AI groups meaning

What this plugin does

Feedback Insights is meant for qualitative analysis where teachers or administrators need more than word frequency. It groups semantically related responses and keeps each theme traceable back to request-local evidence.

For large selections, responses can be analysed in batches and then consolidated from provisional summaries. Raw student text is not resent during consolidation, and invalid IDs returned by the model are discarded before metrics are calculated.

Features you get
Multiple source providers
Analyse supported Moodle sources through a common provider interface.
Batch processing
Handle larger feedback sets without creating one unbounded prompt.
Theme membership validation
Accept only response IDs that were actually sent in the current request.
Deterministic metrics
Calculate totals and trends in PHP after semantic grouping.
Configurable persistence
Store structured analysis when enabled without persisting raw prompts or raw model responses.
Privacy boundaries
Respect source permissions and keep individual-level judgement out of the workflow.

Also requires AI Bridge.
